items.description: S0-AD system with atmospheric/quantum sensing integration

notes: DoW assessment aircraft with quantum sensing payload. SRI Center for Innovation conducting Department of War-sponsored assessment of quantum sensing technologies (atomic vapor magnetometers, inertial sensors). Ryan Nesselrodt (SRI) scheduled in-person interview July 28–29, 2026 with BST team to discuss UAV-based sensing applications and customer end-user considerations. Active flight testing at Murphy's Pond: 3 successful flights completed 2026-06-28 (CO2, photogrammetry, CH4 payloads). Flight #4 scheduled Aug 5–7. System integration and payload development ongoing.
